extracted.intended_audience: prospective AHRQ grant applicants (researchers, institutions, administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on AHRQ funding opportunity types (RFAs, PAs) and the procedural/quality requirements for preparing and submitting grant applications, including deadline/receipt rules, funding/award expectations, and how applications are assigned and peer reviewed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for Applications (RFAs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for Applications (RFAs) are issued to invite grant applications in a well-defined scientific area to stimulate activity in AHRQ programmatic research priority areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A single application receipt date is specified, and the announcement identifies the amount of funds earmarked for the initiative and the number of awards likely to be funded. Applications received in response to a particular RFA are reviewed by an appropriate AHRQ Study Section or by a special review group. All RFAs are published in the NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Announcements (PAs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Program Announcements (PAs) describe continuing, new, or expanded program interests for which grant or cooperative agreement applications are invited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications in response to PAs are reviewed in the same manner as unsolicited grant applications (i.e., by peer review committees of the AHRQ Initial Review Group [IRG]). All PAs are published in the NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single application receipt date specified
rubrics_metrics.description: A single application receipt date is specified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RFAs set a single receipt date that applicants must meet; adherence to this date is a procedural requirement of the announcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Announcement identifies amount of funds earmarked and number of awards likely
rubrics_metrics.description: The announcement identifies the amount of funds earmarked for the initiative and the number of awards likely to be funded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should use the announced funding level and expected number of awards to inform proposed budget and scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications evaluated for responsiveness to the RFA before review
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are evaluated for responsiveness to the RFA before review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Responsiveness screening occurs prior to scientific peer review; failure to be responsive to the specific RFA scope may prevent further review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review by appropriate AHRQ Study Section or special review group
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications received in response to a particular RFA are reviewed by an appropriate AHRQ Study Section or by a special review group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RFAs may trigger assignment to a specially convened review panel tailored to the RFA's scientific focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer review for Program Announcements (AHRQ IRG)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications in response to PAs are reviewed in the same manner as unsolicited grant applications (i.e., by peer review committees of the AHRQ Initial Review Group [IRG]).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants to PAs should expect standard IRG peer review processes and criteria applied to unsolicited submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of RFAs and PAs in the NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: All RFAs are published in the NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts. All PAs are published in the NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should consult the NIH Guide for the official announcement text and details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) Guidance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site references NOFO guidance as an authoritative source for preparing and understanding application requirements; applicants should review NOFO guidance associated with each announcement.
